external_entities.name: calling service
external_entities.description: Another product team's backend consuming inference; two of them run in a different cloud.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway

external_entities.name: ml engineer
external_entities.description: Engineer who publishes new model artifacts to the registry.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: Internet-exposed FastAPI service on GKE; authenticates callers by API key, forwards requests, and logs every request and response.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE that we expose on the internet

processes.name: model server
processes.description: GPU-backed server that loads model artifacts at startup, reads customer features, and runs inference.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network

data_stores.name: model registry
data_stores.description: Bucket holding model artifacts, loaded unverified at model server startup and written by engineers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket.

data_stores.name: feature store
data_stores.description: Redis holding per-customer features: account age and spend bands. No password configured.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Redis has no password on it; it is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: BigQuery table of every request and response, including raw prompts typed by end users.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That means raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: submit inference request
data_flows.description: A product backend submits an inference request over the internet.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Callers pass an API key in a header. Keys are issued per calling team and we have never expired one.
data_flows.authentication: per-team API key in a header, never expired or rotated

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: Gateway forwards the request into the model network.
data_flows.source_excerpt: There is no auth between the gateway and the model server; the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway.

data_flows.name: load artifact
data_flows.description: Model server pulls its model artifact at startup and loads it without verifying integrity.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup. It uses its own service account for that.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: Model server reads per-customer features for a request.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network. Redis has no password on it
data_flows.data_description: account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write request log
data_flows.description: Gateway records the full request and response for debugging.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging.

data_flows.name: publish artifact
data_flows.description: Engineer pushes a new model artifact into the registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account.
data_flows.authentication: unknown; possibly a shared group account

trust_boundaries.name: public internet
trust_boundaries.description: Where calling services sit, including two in a different cloud.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: we expose on the internet because two of the calling services are in a different cloud

trust_boundaries.name: serving edge
trust_boundaries.description: Internet-exposed serving tier holding the gateway and its request log.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE that we expose on the internet

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: Internal GPU network holding the model server, its registry and the feature store.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway

assumptions.assumption: ML engineers work from inside the model network rather than over the public internet.
assumptions.basis: No remote-access path is described for artifact publication; the registry is stated to sit in the model network.

assumptions.assumption: The inference log contains personal data.
assumptions.basis: Stated to hold raw prompts carrying "whatever the calling team's users typed".
